name: detect-idle
description: Freelancer idle detection with push alerts to the client

scripts.dist: npm run dist:client && npm run dist:freelancer
scripts.dist:portable: electron-builder --win portable -c.extraMetadata.detectIdleRole=client -c.appId=com.detectidle.client -c.productName="Detect Idle Client" -c.directories.output=dist/portable-client -c.win.icon=src/assets/icon-client.ico && electron-builder --win portable -c.extraMetadata.detectIdleRole=freelancer -c.appId=com.detectidle.freelancer -c.productName="Detect Idle Freelancer" -c.directories.output=dist/portable-freelancer -c.win.icon=src/assets/icon-freelancer.ico
